# gns3_template (Data Source)

Looks up a GNS3 template by `name` or `template_id`. Exactly one must be set. Built-in templates (VPCS, Ethernet switch, Ethernet hub, Cloud, NAT, ...) need no image.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gns3_template" "vpcs" {
  name = "VPCS"
}

data "gns3_template" "switch" {
  name = "Ethernet switch"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) Template name, for example `VPCS`. Must match exactly one template.
- `template_id` (String) Template UUID.

### Read-Only

- `builtin` (Boolean) Whether the template ships with GNS3.
- `category` (String) `router`, `switch`, `guest` or `firewall`.
- `compute_id` (String) Default compute, null for built-in templates.
- `symbol` (String) Symbol path.
- `template_type` (String) Emulator type, for example `vpcs` or `qemu`.
